name: Cision
description: Integrates the Cision (TrendKite) Communications Cloud API and renders media mentions/coverage of a saved Cision search in a block.
project_description: This module provides a service and blocks that integrate with the Cision Next Generation Cision Communications Cloud API (hosted at api.trendkite.com). The cision.api service authenticates with a stored username/password (managed through the Key module) and exposes methods for Total Mentions, Searches, and Stats. A configurable Cision Total Mentions block renders the media mentions of a chosen saved search and time period, enriching each mention with a thumbnail discovered via the embed/embed library and rendered through imagecache_external. Requires the key, media, image, and imagecache_external modules.
